evals.prompt: Build an MCP server for the gs-billing-app backend. Its AI tools live in playground/gs-billing-app/ai-fixtures/lib/models/ai_chatbot/ai_gpt_fn_billing.py (copy the whole playground/gs-billing-app/ai-fixtures/lib/ tree to playground/mcp-builder-test/eval-1/lib/ first). Expose all tools; no CRUD entities. Create the server as playground/mcp-builder-test/eval-1/mcp-server/mcp_server.py with the full sibling-directory scaffolding (package.json, client configs, README).
evals.expected_output: mcp_server.py wrapping get_invoice_status_func plus auth tools, and the mcp-server directory scaffolding with app-specific names
expectations: Creates mcp-server/mcp_server.py that passes python3 -m py_compile (runtime validity)
The server imports cac as cac_billing and get_invoice_status_func from lib.models.ai_chatbot.ai_gpt_fn_billing, and cac_billing is in cac_object_list
Has an async @mcp.tool() get_invoice_status with a typed invoice_id parameter that calls verify_app_context, delegates to get_invoice_status_func({...}) and returns tool_result(result)
Has the standard auth block: get_api_keys tool, authentication_tool using mcp_authenticate, and the user://login resource
All four client config JSON files parse and contain the app's own server name — none contain the string 'genericsuite-codegen' (runtime validity + stale-template check)

evals.prompt: EXTEND an existing MCP server: first copy playground/mcp-builder-test/eval-1/ (produced by eval 1; if absent, build it per eval 1 first) to playground/mcp-builder-test/eval-2/. A new tool module playground/mcp-builder-test/eval-2/lib/models/ai_chatbot/ai_gpt_fn_finance.py must be created first as a copy of ai_gpt_fn_billing.py with get_invoice_status renamed to fetch_exchange_rate everywhere (including the cac import alias context). Then run mcp-builder on playground/mcp-builder-test/eval-2/ to add the new tool to mcp-server/mcp_server.py.
evals.expected_output: mcp_server.py gains the fetch_exchange_rate wrapper and cac_finance; the existing get_invoice_status wrapper is untouched and not duplicated
expectations: The extended mcp_server.py passes python3 -m py_compile (runtime validity)
Contains exactly ONE @mcp.tool() wrapper for get_invoice_status and exactly ONE for fetch_exchange_rate (no duplicates)
cac_object_list contains both cac_billing and cac_finance
Reports which wrappers were added and which were skipped as already present
